Non-blocking: The AMP smoke test does not exercise LSO overflow skips. In Keras 2.10, LossScaleOptimizerV3 advances inner.iterations on skipped steps too, so the assertion iterations == n_finite + first_applied only holds when every step was finite. Fix the comment and the report claim, or add a forced-overflow test that asserts the scale halves and BN rolls back.
